title: Founder charter-oath compact structure
scope: Qualitative charter-oath assembly structure of the settlement's standing founder-council compact: oath-defined dynastic duties and limits, assembly-chosen council with oath adjudication and burden-consent powers, hearth-based representation, sworn expert testimony, and known ambiguity classes; usable for culture, politics, and story development without establishing names, texts, counts, procedures, law content, succession outcomes, or resolution of the designed first-succession ambiguity.
claims: A standing founder-council compact governs the settlement and rests on a binding founding oath the founder swore in the founding era, within the accepted 25-35-years-ago founding range.

The oath defines the dynasty's duties — defence, outward dealings, and upholding the compact — and its limits: no burden without consent, no seizure of households' subsistence, and no altering the compact alone.

The council is chosen by an assembly of the settlement's households and holds two powers: it adjudicates disputes over whether the oath has been kept, and its consent is required for communal burdens.

Both sides hold real, actually exercised authority: the dynasty's authority is real and broad within the oath's bounds, the council's is real because it judges those bounds and holds consent, and neither side is merely ceremonial.
Dynasty-side office classes are the oath-bound ruling seat and a sworn deputy class under the same oath.

Council-assembly-side office classes are an adjudicator class hearing oath disputes, a burden-consent class conveying or refusing assembly consent, and an oath-witness class keeping the compact's memory and records, which are fallible, incomplete, and disputable.

Refugee and newcomer representation enters at the assembly root: standing follows the household hearth regardless of origin, so newcomer households vote once established, with contested margins over dependents, lodgers, and the not-yet-householded.

Craft, harvest, defence, and System-study expertise enters as sworn testimony in adjudication and burden deliberation; harvest knowledge-holders exist and hold that recognised testimonial standing; System-study testimony interprets accessible signs, never a guaranteed readout.
The compact is a human institution — customary, fallibly recorded, socially enforced — and no office, title, or compact term carries any System-granted power or enforcement.
The ageing founder still rules at story start, and the settlement's first succession under the compact is approaching.

The compact's known ambiguity classes are: whether the founding oath binds heirs automatically, only upon re-swearing, or lapses with the founder, it having been sworn by a living founder who has never needed replacing; whether the assembly or the council receives a successor's oath; which disputed recollections of the oath's terms control when witnesses disagree; and how adjudication proceeds if the seat itself is the disputed party during a succession.

The first-succession provisions are incompletely specified or contested in some respect — known at story start and deliberately unresolved here — and emergency authority, wherever placed, is grounded in the accepted ordinary crisis classes, never in System events.
boundaries: This record is a forward extension filling part of WLD-LOCATION-001's declared-open founder, dynasty, council, succession, law, tenure, and labour institution space; it moves no accepted claim and narrows no other record's declared-open question beyond the declared closures stated here.

Oath, charter, compact, ruling seat, sworn deputy class, adjudicator class, burden-consent class, oath-witness class, assembly, household hearth, standing, and testimony are author-facing qualitative descriptions fixing no in-world name, title text, oath or law-code wording, office count, membership number, seat count, quorum, calendar, procedure, or enforcement mechanism.

No oath text is established; the oath's terms are partly disputed recollection, the oath-witness records are fallible, incomplete, and disputable, and no written charter, complete text, or authoritative copy exists as canon.

The first-succession ambiguity is a designed open pressure: no succession process, outcome, candidate, heir, contender, faction roster, or current dispute is established, and resolution belongs to story evidence and WLD-EVENT-001's pressure framing, never to background fact.

Assembly standing follows the household hearth, but the contested margins over dependents, lodgers, and the not-yet-householded, and every assembly size, cadence, quorum, selection procedure, and actual representation rule, remain undefined.
No property, tenure, or ownership regime is established beyond the stated office classes; consent to communal burdens is abstract only.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006's open harvest space closes only by the single declared qualitative closure that harvest knowledge-holders exist and hold sworn testimonial standing; every harvest technique, practice, law, institution, ownership, trade, ritual, preservation method, community organisation, and competence-recognition mechanism remains open.

WLD-ECOLOGY-004 continues to own the grounded ordinary crisis classes; emergency authority attaches to those classes and adds no migration behaviour, hostility, or System cause, while exact warning, closure, barrier, compensation, and emergency procedures remain open.

WLD-CULTURE-001 continues to establish that watch duty exists and is crewed across strands; this record assigns no watch office, command, levy authority, roster, or watch-related obligation beyond the dynasty's qualitative defence duty, and presupposes no spatial arrangement of households or origin communities.
WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole authority for the founding range and the wider chronology; this record adds no date, sequence, emergency history, precedent, or past adjudication.
No road, water, or shore authority, toll, keeper, patrol, or ownership is created over any accepted location, and no wall form, gate count, or defensive performance is fixed.

The compact's structure is author-side institutional truth; a character knows the compact's terms, ambiguities, and disputes only through an available source — memory, witness, testimony, record, or instruction — every such source is fallible, and how the compact is known, misunderstood, or mythologised remains open.

Offices grant social authority only under CAL0 SOC1.2D; no party mechanics or pooled capability under CAL0 SOC1.0D; System-study access and interpretation only, never a guaranteed appraisal or readout, under CAL0 UI1.2D; no eligibility or authority by category or band under CAL0 WLD1.0D and WLD2.2D; no CAL0 change, new mechanic, constant, or notification behaviour is established.
Governance work consumes ordinary finite labour and time; nothing creates enforcement, compliance, or unity as free goods.
The parked sapient pack species remains parked and gains no development; how returning non-human peoples relate to the outward-dealings duty remains open, unflattened and undeveloped here.
This record adopts no WLD-SOUL-001A, WLD-PRENATAL-001A, or other project default, and makes no protagonist, character, plot, chapter, or story-event claim.
story_implications: Later scenes may use the oath's duties and limits, the assembly and council powers, sworn testimony, and the known ambiguity classes as structural pressure while preserving every actual dispute, adjudication, refusal, succession move, and outcome for its own evidence.
The designed first-succession ambiguity gives WLD-EVENT-001's story-start pressures a contestable structural process without naming candidates, factions, or outcomes.
Refugee and newcomer households hold a real but imperfect channel through hearth standing, and the contested margins can motivate later friction without new institutions.
The compact lives in fallible memory and disputed recollection, so witnesses can disagree and characters know the compact only through available, fallible sources.
system_implications: The compact is ordinary social organisation under CAL0 SOC1.0D and SOC1.2D, not a System structure; no office, title, or compact term carries System-granted power or enforcement.

System-study testimony is access and interpretation only under CAL0 UI1.2D, with no guaranteed appraisal or readout, and no eligibility or authority follows from category or band under CAL0 WLD1.0D and WLD2.2D.
No CAL0 change, new mechanic, constant, or notification behaviour is established, and emergency authority attaches to ordinary crisis classes, never to System events.
research_questions: What in-world names and title wording attach to the seat, offices, council, assembly, compact, and oath?
What exact first-succession process unfolds and how is it resolved — deliberately unresolved here; the ambiguity classes feed WLD-EVENT-001 and must not be settled as background fact?
What assembly-standing margins, council size, seat counts, cadence, quorum, and selection procedures operate in practice?
How is sworn expert standing recognised in practice for craft, harvest, defence, and System-study voices, and how contested is that recognition?
What is the compact's record form — what is written, remembered, witnessed, or disputed, and who keeps it?
What law content of any kind exists — offences, penalties, tenure, inheritance, water and road arrangements, and every harvest question?
What history of past emergencies, adjudications, reviews, and precedents does the compact carry?
How do returning non-human peoples relate to the outward-dealings duty, with their histories and aims unflattened and undeveloped here?
How is the compact known, misunderstood, or mythologised inside and outside the settlement, and through which fallible sources?

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'C — Charter-oath assembly' in the explicit multiple-choice review of the founder-council compact proposal, accepting Option C exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
